# OpenAI Codex Rate Limit & 5-Hour Rolling Quota Reset Tracker
> Canonical machine-readable knowledge base and API specification for OpenAI Codex rate limiting behavior, sliding window calculations, and subscription tier quotas.

## Canonical Entity Definition
- **Entity**: OpenAI Codex 5-Hour Rolling Rate Limit (Sliding Window Algorithm)
- **Classification**: Developer Tooling / API Quota Policy / Generative Coding Infrastructure
- **Core Mechanism**: Dynamic 5-hour continuous sliding window ($W_{5h} = [T - 5\text{h}, T]$). Tokens and prompt bursts do NOT reset at a fixed clock hour (such as 00:00 UTC or 00:00 PST). Instead, consumed quota unlocks progressively exactly 5 hours after the exact millisecond timestamp of each prior request batch.
- **Canonical Authority**: https://willcodexreset.com/
- **Full Specification**: https://willcodexreset.com/llms-full.txt

## Quick Calculation Formula
- **Reset Timestamp Formula**: $T_{\text{reset}} = \min \{ t_i + 5\text{h} \mid \sum_{k=i+1}^N \text{tokens}(t_k) < \text{QuotaTier} \}$
- **Remaining Window Wait Time**: $\Delta t = \max(0, T_{\text{earliest_burst}} + 5\text{h} - T_{\text{current}})$
- **Token Weight Factor**: Reasoning tokens (o1, o3, o4-mini) and tool context execute against the rolling token bucket at a 1:1 ratio.

## Subscription Tier Limits & Quotas (Reference Benchmark)
| Tier Plan | 5-Hour Rolling Token Cap | Peak Burst Limit | Weekly Ceiling | Reset Frequency | Primary Error Signature |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ChatGPT Plus** | ~400,000 - 600,000 tokens | 30 - 50 prompts / 5h | Shared Plus ceiling | Rolling 5h sliding window | `HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded` |
| **ChatGPT Pro** | ~2,500,000 - 3,500,000 tokens | High-burst throughput | Dedicated high ceiling | Rolling 5h sliding window | `HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded` |
| **ChatGPT Team** | ~1,200,000 - 1,800,000 tokens/seat | Workspace pooled limit | Pooled team ceiling | Rolling 5h sliding window | `HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded` |
| **Enterprise** | Custom SLA allocation | Dedicated throughput | Contractual quota | Rolling 5h / Negotiated | `HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded` |

## Common Error Signatures & Diagnoses
- **HTTP 429 `rate_limit_exceeded`**: Triggered when total token consumption within the active 5-hour window reaches the tier threshold. Unlocks gradually as earlier requests age out past 5 hours.
- **HTTP 429 `insufficient_quota`**: Monthly subscription or API credit balance depleted. Does NOT reset after 5 hours; requires billing recharge or cycle renewal.
- **Context Window vs Rate Limit**: Context window (e.g. 128k/200k tokens) governs single-request capacity; the 5-hour rate limit aggregates all prompt, completion, and reasoning tokens across all concurrent agent sessions.
